Shield Of Law (Inevitable8 Abju): 20 creatures within 20' slow successful chaotic attackers (save Will negates) and gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, SR 25 vs. chaotic spells and casters, an additional +2 save to suppress existing mental control and possession, and immunity to new attempts to control or possess, for 20 rd
Summon Monster IX (Inevitable9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
